content.short: Wen Moon Market is a multi-chain NFT marketplace.
content.description: Since its launch in December 2022, Wen Moon Market has offered a broad collection of unique digital assets across multiple blockchains. The platform makes it easy to discover and own one-of-a-kind NFTs, inviting collectors to participate in a growing digital economy. With a focus on accessibility and low fees, Wen Moon Market enables buyers to build their NFT collections without high costs, while exploring a diverse range of assets across networks such as Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Solana, and BNB Chain.
